findings.title: Customer requests seat-count increase to clear internal coaching waitlist
findings.description: Marco raises that Bristlecone has grown headcount since signing and has been maintaining an internal waitlist (roughly 15-20 people) of staff who want to join the coaching program but can't fit under the current seat allocation. This is a contract/commercial seat-count negotiation for the renewal, not a defect or missing capability in the BetterBark product itself.
findings.quote: Is our seat count right? That's actually my question. We've grown since we signed.
findings.severity_reason: Purely a commercial licensing/allocation matter with no product defect or capability gap involved.
findings.match_note: No catalogue issue covers seat allocation; excluded as a commercial matter, not a product bug/feature.

findings.title: Customer requests anonymized impact examples included in renewal proposal

Maya agrees to include a short anonymized impact summary in the proposal document. This is a sales/account-services reporting request, not a product capability.
findings.quote: I'd like to see one or two anonymized examples of the kind of impact you mentioned — the leadership-development stuff — just something concrete for my own peace of mind.
findings.severity_reason: A one-off reporting favor for the renewal proposal, not a product defect or missing platform capability.
